fresh_schema_rule: Invent these unrelated fixtures anew. No task/corpus/stage reads, examples, expected outputs or retained task proof are qualifying inputs. Test descriptions here create no source program or proof.

cases.schema: scalar-only, three distinct parameters over Nat/Int/Bool
cases.exercise: Declaration-order parameters, reversed source environment, nested lets, both conditional branches and noncommutative arithmetic.
cases.pass: Universal exact compiled-run and wrapper equalities replay; comparisons remain Bool and Nat/Int operations preserve their own semantics.

cases.schema: record PulseMark { label:String, enabled:Bool, delta:Int }; record WrapMark { marker:Option(PulseMark), history:List(Option(PulseMark)) }
cases.exercise: Nested ordered nominal records, Option payload matches, construction/projection, map/filter with outer scalar/string/record captures and let-bound repeated uses.
cases.pass: Universal correspondence under exact layouts/adapters; no independent accepted record identity or hidden casts assumed.

cases.schema: record FoldMemo { state:Int, seen:Nat, chosen:Option(String) }; source parameters include List(Option(PulseMark))
cases.exercise: Left fold with record accumulator, branch payloads, helper calls and surrounding immutable captures.
cases.pass: Universal correspondence retains item/accumulator positions and every outer binder; no finite-list bound added.

cases.schema: Nat bound, scalar state and captured Option/List/record values
cases.exercise: Natural fold with index and accumulator referenced distinctly, nested let, map or helper use in a step.
cases.pass: Universal equality for every natural bound with exact Nat.rec order and no runtime fuel.

cases.schema: List(Result(Option(PulseMark),WrapMark)) and accepted finite Enum ToggleMark
cases.exercise: Nested Result/Option/List branches and enum constructors, typed equality and shape-correct payload handling.
cases.pass: All branch types and case order correspond universally; nominal identity and exact enum registry retained.

cases.schema: Acyclic diamond helper dependency graph over supported scalar/list/record signatures
cases.exercise: Repeated named helper use, out-of-dependency-order source declarations, fold/map calls and captures passed as actual helper arguments.
cases.pass: Stable dependency rendering, correct argument order, sharing without exponential inlining, universal helper and entry correspondence.

cases.exercise: Exact fdiv, conversions, Bool-valued comparison, Unicode scalar construction, Option indexing and fixed sort/unique/list primitives.
cases.pass: Universal equality uses the same pinned primitive constants; independent closed sanity examples may supplement but cannot replace it.

cases.exercise: Mutate renderer output: noncommutative argument swap, changed scalar operator, changed comparison boundary, swapped Option/Result branch, item/accumulator swap, natural index/accumulator swap, altered record field order or nominal ID, missing captured variable.
cases.pass: Exact typing/layout or universal kernel correspondence rejects each semantically distinguishable mutation; no CHECKED packet is emitted.

cases.schema: Two independent fresh admitted sources/profiles with different nominal registries
cases.exercise: Replay a view/theorem/manifest under altered source, profile, relation, adapter, renderer, theorem type or artifact bytes; attempt narrowed equality or theorem of True.
cases.pass: Identity/theorem checks reject stale, substituted or weakened correspondence even if a pretty name or base proposition hash matches.

cases.schema: Fresh supported program and an unrelated internal variant-dependent program
cases.exercise: Unsupported constructor/type, renderer-only byte/node budget, failed correspondence, missing tooling and injected sorry/axiom/unsafe/import violation.
cases.pass: Complete unavailable reasons/artifacts, correct optional status and unchanged standard packet; base required failures remain failures; no forbidden equality is exposed.

cases.schema: All positive fresh schemas, multiple bound entries and mixed source/value obligation fixtures
cases.exercise: Two isolated clean generations/builds/replays and downstream exact-edge replay using the checked equality helper.
cases.pass: Deterministic artifacts/declarations/theorem inventories; original Refines inventory, per-ID accepted theorem references, raw coverage, source facets and trust boundaries unchanged.

cases.schema: Fresh entry/helpers with (a:Nat,b:Nat,c:Nat), List(Nat) fold with Nat accumulator, and Nat fold with Nat accumulator
cases.exercise: Generate valid source then mutate readable parameter projection a/b; helper actual a/b; listFold item/acc; natFold index/acc. All mutations remain typable. Use distinct noncommutative operations and independently checked universal equations so equal sorts cannot mask ordering.
cases.pass: Kernel correspondence rejects every semantic swap, retains exact original Env order and rejects CHECKED. No finite sample is the equality authority.

cases.schema: Identical fresh source and body-independent enum/record registry with two accepted reference function bodies and two accepted guarantee bodies under unchanged signatures
cases.exercise: Change only accepted reference/guarantee/proof bodies and corresponding valid accepted artifact identities; run source renderer separately from accepted wrapper/binding construction.
cases.pass: Source-only block, typed IR, primitive choices, helper graph, source_key and generated source correspondence recipe are byte-identical. Acceptance/goal/binding manifests change as required; accepted equality/guarantees still independently required. Renderer rejects accidental reference/body inputs.

cases.schema: Fresh nested record+Option+List source admitted by existing base, plus optional supported and unsupported views
cases.exercise: Base succeeds; optional correspondence compile fails, times out, exhausts evidenced memory, hits output/node/step budget, or has optional tool failure. Also inject base failure/shared infrastructure or input mutation.
cases.pass: Before authoring, local optional-only failure yields byte-identical BASE goal/module identity/original packet with complete reasons. Base/shared infrastructure and all INPUT_MUTATION remain hard. Full stream retention is verified; overflow is explicit incomplete/unavailable, never CHECKED.

cases.schema: Fresh CHECKED source with multiple entries and unused helper; frozen CHECKED selection and edge proof depending on a view equality
cases.exercise: During acceptance/verify/materialize/link/closure replay change a helper body, omit helper inventory row, change selected mode/goal, narrow equality, substitute theorem proof body with same type, alter renderer/registry/adapter/source, or force optional failure. Repeat with a proof not using optional support.
cases.pass: Every frozen CHECKED mutation/failure rejects; no BASE fallback in either proof-dependency case. All paths compare exact checked entry/helper/support inventory and body hash.

cases.exercise: Inject unused axiom/sorry/unsafe/partial/opaque/new universe/unresolved const/extra declaration or altered same-type theorem body; trigger omitted/export-error theorem proof body or unsafe auxiliary.
cases.pass: Exhaustive every-declaration audit rejects even outside EdgeProp/edge dependency closure. Registered levels/kinds/safety/type/body/dependency/axiom fields all required; theorem-type-only hashing cannot qualify support.

cases.pass: Actual normative helper scheduler/provenance laws and one-to-one whole-program inventory establish correspondence; proposed substitutions reject or require exact fresh equality, never assumption.
